extensionName.message: Threads Plugin - Clean Links & Media Saver
extensionName.description: Primary English name shown in the Chrome Web Store and extension manager.

extensionDescription.message: Download images and videos from Threads posts, copy post text, or copy clean links with tracking parameters removed.
extensionDescription.description: English summary shown in Chrome Web Store search results and the extension manager.

actionTitle.description: English tooltip for the extension toolbar action.

optionsIntro.message: All processing takes place in your browser. The extension does not send post content or media URLs to a developer-operated server.

consentDescription.message: Threads Plugin reads post text, links, and media information from Threads pages and adds feature buttons only after you enable it.

batchPickerLabel.message: Show the batch post media picker

networkCaptureLabel.message: Advanced network response capture (off by default)

networkCaptureDescription.message: This feature intercepts known feed/post GraphQL responses in the main world of Threads pages and extracts only allowlisted post codes, media types, and media URLs. It does not run on sensitive routes such as login, messages, or settings, and it does not send data to a developer-operated server.

networkCaptureReenableDescription.message: After advanced capture is disabled or consent is revoked, the capture controller is permanently locked for the current document. Reload the tab before using capture again after re-enabling it in an already open tab.

networkCaptureDialogDescription.message: When enabled, this feature reads known GraphQL feed/post responses in the main world of Threads pages to improve video and carousel media detection. It retains only validated post codes, media types, and media URLs. Raw responses do not leave the page or go to the developer. After confirming, reload any open Threads tabs; a document whose capture controller was previously stopped will not restart automatically.

consentStatusEnabled.message: Consent granted; page features will run

consentStatusDisabled.message: Consent not granted; the extension remains dormant

networkCaptureEnabledStatus.message: Advanced capture is enabled. Reload any Threads tab where advanced capture was previously disabled or consent was revoked.

disclosureHeading.message: Choose Whether to Allow Page Content Processing

disclosureIntro.message: When enabled, the extension locally reads Threads post text, links, and media URLs, then adds download and copy buttons. Data is not sent to a developer-operated server.

disclosureAdvancedStrong.message: Advanced network response capture remains off.

disclosureAdvancedBody.message: If you enable it later, the settings page will explain it and ask for separate consent.

privacyIntro.message: Threads Plugin provides user-invoked Threads media downloads, post-text copying, and clean-link copying in your browser. The extension has no developer-operated backend, analytics, advertising, or tracking.

privacyDataP1.message: Only after you consent to page-content processing does the extension handle post text, user-generated content, post links, the current route, public author names or identifiers, post codes, media URLs and types, DOM information required to display controls, and trusted click, pointer, scroll, and keyboard events needed to complete your actions on supported Threads pages.

privacyDataP2.message: The extension does not read Threads passwords, authentication cookies, payment information, or private-message content. The page runtime does not start on sensitive login, account, challenge, messages, OAuth, security, privacy, or settings routes.

privacyDataP3.message: Advanced network response capture requires separate opt-in consent and is off by default. It inspects only allowlisted feed/post GraphQL responses. A bounded same-page bridge returns validated post codes, media types and URLs, source routes, allowlisted operation names, and random anti-replay protocol data to the isolated content context. Raw response bodies are not sent to the service worker, developer, or an external server.

privacyUseP1.message: Data is used only for the extension's single purpose: the Threads post media downloads, post-text copies, or clean-link copies you request, plus local media ordering, post and route isolation, UI display, consent, and security restrictions. Threads Plugin does not sell data, use it for advertising, profiling, credit, or lending decisions, or make it available for human reading by the developer or anyone else.

privacyUseP2.message: The extension does not send page content or media records to the developer or unrelated analytics, advertising, or tracking services. When you request a download, Chrome makes the necessary HTTPS request to the selected media's original and approved Threads, Instagram, CDN Instagram, or FBCDN host. That host receives the ordinary request needed to return the file. There is no other external transmission.

privacyRetentionP1.message: stores only normalized feature and timing options plus consent state. It does not store post text, media URLs, browsing history, cookies, credentials, analytics identifiers, or downloaded content.

privacyRetentionP2.message: Parsed text, links, and media records may remain in the current tab's memory while the consented runtime is active. Post and route identity checks prevent old records from being used for another post or route. These records are cleared when consent is revoked, the runtime stops, including after entering a sensitive route, or the tab closes, and the extension does not persist them.

privacyRetentionP3.message: Text or links you ask to copy are written to the operating-system clipboard and retained according to your operating system or clipboard-manager settings. Download URLs, filenames, Chrome download history, and downloaded files are retained according to Chrome and operating-system settings.

privacyControlP1.message: The extension remains dormant before consent. You may decline without repeated prompts, enable processing later from the settings page, disable advanced capture independently, or revoke all consent. After revocation, open Threads tabs stop the runtime, remove injected UI, stop the MAIN wrapper, remove the same-page bridge listener, and unregister future MAIN capture. Page processing remains off until you consent again.

privacyControlP2.message: When advanced capture is disabled or all consent is revoked, the service worker also performs an authoritative stop in the MAIN world of every open tab. It immediately restores the fetch and XHR wrappers and permanently locks the controller for the current document, so page code or reinjection cannot restart capture. If you re-enable advanced capture in the same open tab, reload the tab or open a new document before capture can run again. General DOM tools continue to follow page-content consent independently.

privacySecurityP1.message: Media download URLs must use HTTPS, contain no credentials or unexpected port, use an approved Threads, Instagram, or CDN host, and have an explicit media extension. The service worker validates them again. Capture is also restricted by exact operation, route, schema, record count, payload size, media URL, and replay checks. The extension runs only packaged code and uses no remote JavaScript.

privacyLimitedUseBefore.message: Threads Plugin's use and handling of information received from Chrome extension APIs and supported Threads pages adheres to the

privacyLimitedUseAfter.message: , including its Limited Use requirements. Information is used only to provide or improve the disclosed single purpose, is not transferred except as necessary to provide that purpose or as otherwise permitted by the policy, is not used for personalized advertising, and is not made available for human reading.

privacyContactAfter.message: . Do not include private post content, credentials, or other sensitive information in a public issue. Material policy changes will update this page's date and release notes.
